title: Wildfly: unauthenticated remote attacker can craft a CORE protocol SESSION_REATTACH packet to steal an existing…
description: A critical security vulnerability in Wildfly allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to craft a CORE protocol SESSION_REATTACH packet to hijack an existing session and assume the privileges of that session. This flaw affects Wildfly versions prior to 42.0.0-r1 and has a CVSS score of 9.8, indicating a high severity with full confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact.
